title: [29x]-Create Movement from Movement Worksheet doesn't respect Quantity nor Qty. to Handle if we Get Bin Content
summary: The Create Movement from Movement Worksheet process now correctly applies the specified quantity and quantity to handle values when retrieving bin content, instead of ignoring these limits during bin lookups.
key_points: Fixed quantity constraints being ignored when Get Bin Content is used in movement worksheet
Bin content retrieval now respects the Quantity to Handle field
Bug affected movement creation logic for warehouse activities
Test coverage added to validate the fix
